text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This grand festival has finally arrived!
The Japanese Derby, also known as the Tokyo Yushun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The day when the Umamusume most blessed by the heavens is chosen!
My, oh my, how joyous, how celebratory~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"So basically... I'm playing the role of the shrine maiden
of blessings, so can I sit this one out?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm kidding! I'm totally fired up, you know!
I made a promise with Suzuka-san, after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san has ten times the talent of the big sister I looked up to.
So she's basically ten times the big sister!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I won't go so far as to say that, but I won't chicken out,
and I'll show you what I'm truly capable of.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm someone who relies on luck, I should at least
be able to show that much to you, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Alright, go give it your best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I won't let the Derby's monster
swallow me up! My evil-warding prep
is completely foolproof!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sound health and safety make a truly great horse girl!
I'll finish running without a scratch and achieve my goal!
